steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I can return her to you, Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Don't do it.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Oh? You and your mighty executioners have made my life hell.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Of course I'm willing to return her to you... But the cuffs on her body will tear Lungmen in half.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Damn you...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Wei, this is the method you used against me. The way you forced me out of Lungmen.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But now, our roles are reversed. I'm the guest, as well as the poisoner.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Kashchey. You killed my brother.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No, no, Wei. You slew your own brother.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: My role is irrelevant. Your brother's tragedy may have come from a Unicorn's secret orders, or from the wrath of a Lung. Whether it was me who leaked the news... ultimately, does not matter.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: What's important, Wei, the one thing you mustn't forget... is that your Chi Xiao drank his blood. You did it.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Chi Xiao, the dragonslaying sword. And who is it that this blade slew? Your friends. Your family. Your people.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Dragonslaying sword? How ironic that your people forged a weapon that would be turned against its own kind.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You've gone too far.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Very well. I offer you a choice.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Choose. Slay me, and take back your niece, but lose your city as a result. Or, let us walk free.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Don't draw that sword. You know the consequences.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: (Grinds teeth audibly)

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Relax, Wei. I've let you choose your own fate. If you don't take my generous offer, then you and I both, all your citizens, and these two lovely sisters... will all perish.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What are you scheming?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Wei, old Wei... I know you well. Too well.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You've always had a choice, isn't that right?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: What will your precious citizens think when they hear that their lives have been placed upon a scale? And on the other side... is a young dragon whose name they've never heard.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: As for me, I don't even have a reason to hurt her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Since I was negligent enough to let you step foot back into this city, there's no reason to let you leave again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tal!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Oh really?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll kill you myself.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Now, now. There's no need for that.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: My life is not yours to take.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: By the way, you can save her before I put the handcuffs on her.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But you'll also have to think about defending against me. Defeating me. Striking me down. Annihilating me... And, what I am going to do next.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Wei, you're actually afraid of me, aren't you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: She's here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Finally.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll kill her myself.
Confessarius, answer me.
The Leader of Reunion, is there any value in forming an alliance?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Why ask me about things that you know very well, Your Majesty?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: A youth with no possessions, background, or capital cannot possibly seek to take an important Ursus city alone.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The uninfected rulers know not what to make of her actions.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: They will panic, overreact, and try to resolve the chaos through more destruction — and use the chaos caused by the Infected as a front.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: But, we Sarkaz know better.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: What do you think of the team she finally left here?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: They are unworthy, Your Majesty. As you foresaw, there is no hope for them. They are not trained soldiers, unable to cause the violence that we seek.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Eliminating them will not sever Talulah's power. We lack an opportunity to take her out.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Right, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The situation that she fomented and the power she wielded to force the issue... shows that she is no one-eyed leader among the blind, or some pampered princeling awaiting the throne.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: She is a conspirator.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Even if that is the case, I require a comprehensive response from the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: In that case, I have two bits of good news. First, we already have a lead on our search for the Lord of Fiends.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Rhodes Island hasn't yet been manipulated by foreign forces.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Don't waste time. We need her to begin right now.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Please do not be angered, and hear me out.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: 'She' is ready.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: That power is rightfully ours.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: The true King of Sarkaz is mightier than the heir of any unknown name.
